description: Known suspicious packaging patterns that may indicate counterfeit or substandard medicines.

patterns.explanation: The packaging makes extraordinary cure claims that are not typical of legitimate pharmaceutical products.
The packaging uses exaggerated efficacy language uncommon in legitimate pharmaceutical labeling.
The packaging claims no side effects. Legitimate medicines are required to list potential side effects.
The packaging makes regulatory approval claims combined with origin indicators that may not align.
The packaging references secret formulas without listing specific active ingredients.
The active ingredients are listed as unknown. Legitimate pharmaceutical products must disclose active ingredients.
The packaging uses marketing urgency language uncommon in legitimate pharmaceutical labeling.
